about: The collecta of the formulary “21st Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Guard Your household, we beseech You, O Lord, with unceasing care, that under Your protection it may be free from all harm and serve You by good deeds. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
